effect: Bomberman: invincible (fire and enemies never kill)
note: Game Genie, compare $CD: RET over the hit check, $01:4816 here ($21 earlier than the Japanese cart's $01:4837, the same bytes). GameShark: the after-hit flash flag, the same RAM as the Japanese cart. Random-input bot, 6,000 frames from 1-1: 0 sets lost with either code, 2 without.

effect: Bomberman: win every normal set at once (not boss sets)
note: Game Genie: $01:4869 OR A -> XOR A, so the enemy check sees every page empty ($01:488A in the Japanese cart). With C98-16B-D5D, bot 6,000 frames: 6 sets won, 1-1 to 1-4; the boss set doesn't end. The Japanese cart's GameShark form (010000C1 + 010000C2 + 010000C3) doesn't work here: with it no set ended in 6,000 frames.
